title: markermd grading rubric
description: A markermd grading rubric: per-question rubric items and scoring setup used while marking in mark(). Contains no per-student grading data. A file may cover a single question or every question in a project.

name.description: Question name; must exactly match a question name in the project's grading template.

scoring.description: Optional scoring setup for the question. When omitted the project's existing settings are left unchanged.

items.description: Rubric items in display order. Order is meaningful: the first ten items are bound to keyboard hotkeys 1-9 and 0.

total_score.description: Maximum possible points for the question.

grading_mode.description: "positive" builds the score up from 0 by adding selected item points; "negative" starts from total_score and applies (typically negative) item points as deductions.

bound_above_zero.description: When true the computed score is clamped to be >= 0.

bound_below_max.description: When true the computed score is clamped to be <= total_score.

points.description: Point value applied when the item is selected; negative values are deductions.

description.description: Feedback text shown for the item.
